how.title: How It Works
how.subtitle: Sending love home takes less than 3 minutes
how.pageSubtitle: A simple, secure way to surprise your family and friends in Sri Lanka — wherever you live.
how.step1Desc: Browse cakes, flowers, chocolates, essentials and gift boxes made for every occasion.
how.step2Desc: Pick the delivery date and time, and add a heartfelt message for the card.
how.step3Desc: Transfer the amount to our bank account. We’ll confirm your order once the payment is received.
how.step4Desc: Our team delivers on time and sends you a photo once your gift is received.
how.faq1Q: Which areas do you deliver to?
how.faq1A: We deliver islandwide. Same-day delivery is available in Colombo and suburbs for orders placed before 2:00 PM (Sri Lanka time).
how.faq2Q: Can I choose a delivery date and time?
how.faq2A: Yes. Choose a date and a time slot at checkout — including a midnight surprise slot for birthdays and anniversaries.
how.faq3Q: How will I know my gift was delivered?
how.faq3A: You can track your order any time with your order number, and we send a delivery photo on WhatsApp.
how.faq4Q: Which payment methods do you accept?
how.faq4A: We accept bank transfer. We’ll confirm your order once the payment is received.

why.deliveryDesc: We deliver to Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna and every corner of Sri Lanka.

why.qualityDesc: Cakes baked on the day and flowers hand-picked every morning.
why.paymentDesc: Pay by bank transfer from anywhere in the world.

testimonials.title: Loved by families worldwide
testimonials.subtitle: Real messages from customers sending love home
testimonials.q1: I live in Melbourne and sent a midnight cake for my mother’s birthday. She called me in tears — delivered exactly at 12. Thank you SENDLANKA!
testimonials.q2: Ordering the grocery pack every month for my parents has become so easy. The WhatsApp updates give me real peace of mind.
testimonials.q3: Beautiful roses, fresh and on time for our anniversary. The delivery photo was a lovely touch.
